sketches.intent: A dry-added two-section phase pad; staggered chord entrances retain independent filter envelopes. Independent Ripple-inspired DSP; not an Arturia-identical model or sonic equivalence claim.

Negative phase feedback hollows a triangle-rich lead; note velocity moves the phase center, not a low-pass edge. Independent Ripple-inspired DSP; not an Arturia-identical model or sonic equivalence claim.

Four all-pass sections and moderate post-phase shaping produce bright electric keys with moving dry cancellation. Independent Ripple-inspired DSP; not an Arturia-identical model or sonic equivalence claim.

Positive feedback through four same-frequency all-pass sections; restrained cutoff motion and short notes expose the comb-like structure. Independent Ripple-inspired DSP; not an Arturia-identical model or sonic equivalence claim.

Eight all-pass sections concentrate a brief metallic strike before waveshaping. No copied sample, circuit or Pigments preset. Independent Ripple-inspired DSP; not an Arturia-identical model or sonic equivalence claim.

Eight-section negative feedback with a slowly moving phase center and wet-dominant sum. The explicit feedback input attenuation is not AGC. Independent Ripple-inspired DSP; not an Arturia-identical model or sonic equivalence claim.
